title: Work IQ: how agents reach Microsoft 365 and business data, and what an admin can switch off
summary: Hold: Microsoft has published a Work IQ Tool API rate, so the statement that a per-request credit rate is not yet published needs narrowing. The claim that no separate environment data-participation path is documented also overlooks the documented data-availability setting. The cited control paths and commands were otherwise confirmed.

claims.claim: Work IQ is a workplace intelligence layer that lets agents and applications reason over Microsoft 365 and business data with permission-aware governance.
claims.quote: Work IQ is a workplace intelligence layer that enables agents to access and reason over organizational and business data, context, and tools.

claims.where: summary; What it is; Why it matters
claims.claim: Every request runs in a specific user's context and is limited to that user's access.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: Work IQ exposes A2A, a remote MCP server and a REST API.
claims.quote: Work IQ API endpoints include A2A, a remote MCP server, and a REST API.

claims.claim: MCP means Model Context Protocol and exposes tools to AI agents.
claims.quote: The Work IQ MCP server exposes Microsoft 365 intelligence capabilities to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

claims.claim: Microsoft describes chat, context, tools and workspaces as Work IQ components.
claims.quote: Combining chat, context, tools, and workspaces, Work IQ supports high-volume, multistep interactions

claims.claim: Chat provides conversational intelligence through A2A and REST.
claims.quote: Work IQ supports A2A for agent-to-agent collaboration and REST for web application interactions, enabling agents to delegate work, maintain continuity, and deliver fully processed, Copilot-quality responses.

claims.claim: Work IQ assembles grounded context internally so agents do not need to manage retrieval pipelines.
claims.quote: Work IQ assembles and grounds context internally across organizational and business data to provide agent-ready inputs, so agents don't need to stitch together raw signals or manage retrieval pipelines.

claims.claim: Generic MCP tools act as verbs on resource paths.
claims.quote: These tools function as simple verbs (such as fetch, create, and update), while resource paths define what the agent is working with.

claims.claim: Workspaces use SharePoint Embedded working storage for intermediate data and outputs.
claims.quote: SharePoint Embedded working storage gives agents a persistent space within your Microsoft 365 tenant boundary to manage intermediate data and outputs

claims.where: Risks and limits: Policy is tenant-wide only
claims.claim: The initial MCP policy control surface is tenant-wide, not per-user, per-app, per-agent or scenario-specific.
claims.quote: Tenant-level control applies across the tenant. Per-user, per-app, per-agent, or scenario-specific policy templates aren't part of the initial policy control surface.

claims.claim: Saved policy changes can take up to 24 hours to apply.
claims.quote: After you save the setting, it can take up to 24 hours for the policy change to apply across your tenant.

claims.claim: Tenant policy can deny an authenticated user's request even when the app has the required OAuth permission.
claims.quote: an MCP request can fail because of tenant policy even when the user is authenticated and the app has the required OAuth permission.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Governance controls: How they interact
claims.claim: The MCP Block control covers the whole server separately from audience settings and App Access.
claims.quote: This control applies to the entire Work IQ MCP server, separate from Copilot audience settings or App Access.

claims.claim: Environment feature enablement and environment data participation are separate decisions.
claims.quote: Enabling these features in an environment is a separate decision from allowing Work IQ to reason over that environment's data.

claims.claim: No separate environment data-participation path is documented.
claims.quote: | Allow data availability in Microsoft 365 Copilot | When On, allows Dynamics 365 and Dataverse data to be available in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat. | Off |
claims.fix: Remove ', but no separate path is documented at the time of writing'. The general feature-settings reference documents a separate Allow data availability in Microsoft 365 Copilot setting under Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Dataverse intelligence (preview), alongside the Work IQ feature setting. It covers Copilot Chat data availability; do not imply that it is absent or infer that it controls every MCP data-participation scenario.
